primaryQuery: Does Custom Packaging Need CE Marking? An Artwork Approval Guide
customerDecision: An ordinary empty paper box or shopping bag does not need CE marking merely because it is packaging. CE applies to products covered by specific EU legislation. When a mark is required on the packaged product, whether it also appears on packaging depends on the applicable rules. Obtain product-specific instructions from the responsible manufacturer before printing, and keep those instructions linked to the correct SKU and artwork revision.

primaryQuery: Sedex and SMETA for Packaging Suppliers
customerDecision: Sedex membership and a SMETA audit are different forms of evidence. Membership alone does not establish that a packaging factory has completed an audit, and SMETA is not a product certification or a pass/fail guarantee. Review the actual site, audit date, scope, findings and corrective actions against your sourcing policy. Confirm that the proposed production and any subcontracted work match the evidence you reviewed.
